topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: The sky outside the window had turned to a deepening shade of twilight by the time the gate agent finally spoke. My flight, delayed now for hours, was circling some unseen obstacle in the clouds, never landing, never truly taking off. I had watched the minutes slip away like water through fingers, each one a promise I hadn't kept. The event I was meant to be at, the faces I was meant to see—they had moved on, the world turning without me. Now, as the terminal buzzes around, I'm left here, a passenger on a flight to nowhere, the quiet of the lounge a vast, open space that echoes with every unspoken word.
